chronology.r1_receipt_policy: immutable; never overwrite or relabel as a dry run
chronology.r1_source_hash_race: the running R1 process consumed the 5be754 angle-acos implementation bound by lock b49efb, then hashed the concurrently replaced fd80e5 scipy-magnitude source when writing its receipt; the 3.65e-8 receipt values and reproducible G13 failure prove the consumed 5be754 semantics. R2 preserves the receipt and both identities instead of repairing R1 in place

unchanged_from_r1.g13_thresholds: 0.20 inverse-depth endpoint increase and ln(1.20) integrated endpoint log-radial expansion

r2_repair_scope.package_manifest: freeze the unchanged outer JSONL record envelope plus the explicit MAIN scene v1 and GUARD scene v2 union; classify runtime_manifest.json as byte-identical inherited R0 renderer/environment evidence
r2_repair_scope.g13_numeric_check: verify the source-known component decomposition R_composite=R_periodic and t_composite-t_periodic=[0,0,0.8*phase], then evaluate the approach-only component [I,[0,0,0.8*phase]]; use direct max matrix-component equality at 1e-12 and do not describe this as an SE(3) quotient
r2_repair_scope.g01_g02: independently raycast all 88 reference scenes and recompute depth bands, grid diversity, and depth/object/visibility hashes
r2_repair_scope.g03: compare the frozen projective samples with independent projection and replace the analytic uv1-minus-itself expression with a closed-form pinhole cross-check
r2_repair_scope.g08: compare source-known visibility from the frozen ray/rectangle z-buffer with a separately coded explicit occlusion enumeration over all 160 motion identities and exercise a real analytic disocclusion fixture
r2_repair_scope.g11: validate the exact six-arm Cartesian pairing, exact arm schema, identities, and permitted field differences
r2_repair_scope.g12: derive scene, intrinsic, timestamp, trajectory, and motion geometry identities from frozen source-known geometry instead of trusting equal strings
r2_repair_scope.g14: recompute every first-versus-second replay comparison and add two-build replay coverage for all eight repaired GUARD scenes
r2_repair_scope.hash_completeness: require exact source, evidence, producer artifact, predecessor evidence, replay identity, and receipt key sets before comparing hashes

terminal_logic.repair_policy: No seed replacement, scene selection, threshold reduction, P2 calibration, performance preflight, formal sequence execution, RCLE access, or overwrite of R0/R1 receipts.
